Somewhere between misty morning walks and little hands holding mine, I’m learning that the most beautiful parts of motherhood are often the quietest. 🤍 The little walks, the endless questions, the tiny fingers reaching for mine… these ordinary moments are the ones I know I’ll miss the most someday. As a mom, I often find myself wishing I could slow down time.
